description: Add, change or remove one item in an existing cart. quantity is the total wanted (not an increment); 0 removes it. Send the cart's current version; the result has the new one. If the version is stale, the error includes current_cart. Up to 20 variants and 99 of each; stock is checked.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

quantity.description: The total quantity wanted (not an increment); 0 removes the item.

version.description: The cart's current version, from the last cart result. Each edit increments it.

name: set_cart_item
